text:
alex: Deploy blocked by deploy-bot on release/2026.03.20 — vuln-scan flagged a transitive dependency (xyz@0.2.1). Low severity but pipeline stopped. Need quick decision: pin, rollback, or exception?

deploy-bot: AUTOMATED: pipeline halted. Gate=VULN_SCAN_FAILED.
Vulnerability: CVE-2026-1234 (low)
Package: transitive/xyz@0.2.1
Introduced via: foo@3.1.2
SBOM entry: sha256:af34b9...

ciara: Can we hotpatch in the build step? If it's only telemetry usage, patching the call site might be fast.

ria: What's the blast radius? Is this reachable in prod or only in internal paths? Any evidence of exploit?

alex: quick grep through repo shows usage only in internal telemetry path (metrics exporter). Not hit by our canary traffic. No exploit indicators in logs.

security_jen: Public exploit details surfaced before but seems low impact for our usage. Still recommended to mitigate. Options: pin to 0.2.0 (compatible) or upgrade to 0.2.2 (breaking).

ciara: 0.2.2 exists but upstream changed API; tests fail. 0.2.0 is backwards-compatible. We can force a transitive pin at build time (pip constraint / yarn resolutions / pnpm overrides depending on package).

kevin: If we pin, update SBOM and provenance, and note it in release notes. If we roll back the release commit, that's fastest but loses features queued in this deploy. Change window closes in ~90m.

alex: Timeline/options: 
1) Pin transitive to xyz@0.2.0 and trigger a rebuild (est ~35-50m)
2) Rollback to previous release commit (est ~15m)
3) Request a one-off security exception/approval (likely hours).
Which do people prefer?

ria: Option 1 unless we need the new feature urgent.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Pin will trigger new image build, SBOM regen, and fresh provenance signing. Canary will be re-deployed.

security_jen: I can pre-approve the pin as an emergency mitigation. Please create a remediation ticket and schedule an upgrade path for a non-breaking future bump.

alex: Opening ticket now and adding remediation/owner. Tagging @legal-bot for release note wording.

legal-bot: Suggested customer-facing phrasing: "Dependency update to improve security posture." Avoid referencing CVE details or exploitability in public notes. Internal sec ticket should have full details.

ciara: Opening PR to pin in infra: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 — includes build image change + SBOM regen.

alex: Nice. Once CI green, re-run pipeline and hand canary to dev-sre. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
